Bid Summary.value: The Maryland State Treasurer's Office seeks 30 Microsoft Copilot-ready Dell Latitude 5550 laptops (SI# CC7802), 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4), and three-year extended hardware warranties under PORFP E20P4600040 / eMMA project BPM044557, using Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract 060B5400007. Proposals are due June 10, 2024, at 2:00 PM EDT, must be submitted electronically through eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA), and must remain valid for at least 90 days after the deadline. Delivery is required within 45 days of award; equipment must be new, unused, and ENERGY STAR certified, with warranty coverage lasting three years from delivery. Required documentation includes a Mercury Affidavit, estimated ship dates or lead times for each item, a warranty certificate or affidavit upon award, and a Dell reseller authorization letter if requested by the State. Invoices must be emailed to STOaccountspayable@treasurer.state.md.us within 10 days of equipment delivery and include the specified contractor and invoice details, State-assigned PORFP number, proof of delivery, and equipment serial numbers.
